name: camp fire
description: A low fire of dry scrub and camel dung, banked against the night wind.

state_descriptions.lit: The camp fire burns steadily, and the kettle above it ticks.
state_descriptions.doused: The fire is out, and the ashes are already cold.

name: supply wagon
description: A high-wheeled wagon under a patched canvas, its bed packed with water skins and trade goods.

name: survey map
description: A pinned survey map of the Glass Flats, marked with safe stones and a black cross over the observatory.

name: caravan ledger
description: Sera's ledger lies open on a folding table, its columns weighted against the wind.

name: shard shrine
description: A cairn of dark stones with a splinter of glass set in the top, humming faintly in the heat.

name: prism altar
description: A ring of mirrors around a black stone altar. The air above it bends the light into colours.

state_descriptions.dormant: The altar is dark, but the mirrors still hold a thin line of light.
state_descriptions.awake: The mirrors turn as one, and the altar burns white.

name: surveyor's chest
description: A brass-bound surveyor's chest, half-buried beneath a drifted pane of glass.

content.name: Surveyor's Notes
content.description: Renn's field notes on the observatory's mirrors and the safe paths across the Flats

content.name: Prism Shard
content.description: A fist-sized shard of clear glass that bends the light into a spectrum

content.name: Mirage Tonic
content.description: A pale tonic that steadies the eye and restores health
